name: Usami - Monitor de Erros e Execucoes n8n

parameters.query:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j
),
ins_err AS (
  INSERT INTO obs_error_logs (created_at, source, route_or_workflow, status_code, error_code, error_message, metadata)
  SELECT
    COALESCE((p.j->>'timestamp')::timestamptz, NOW()),
    'n8n-workflow',
    COALESCE(p.j->>'workflowName', p.j->>'workflowId'),
    500,
    p.j->>'mode',
    COALESCE(p.j->>'errorMessage', 'Falha no workflow n8n'),
    jsonb_build_object('workflowId', p.j->>'workflowId', 'executionId', p.j->>'executionId', 'lastNode', p.j->>'lastNode')
  FROM p
)
INSERT INTO obs_n8n_executions (execution_id, created_at, workflow_id, workflow_name, status, mode, error_message)
SELECT
  p.j->>'executionId',
  COALESCE((p.j->>'timestamp')::timestamptz, NOW()),
  p.j->>'workflowId',
  p.j->>'workflowName',
  'error',
  p.j->>'mode',
  p.j->>'errorMessage'
FROM p
ON CONFLICT (execution_id) DO UPDATE SET
  status = EXCLUDED.status,
  error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message;

WITH rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb) AS x(
    execution_id TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    workflow_id TEXT,
    workflow_name TEXT,
    status TEXT,
    mode TEXT,
    duration_ms INT,
    error_message TEXT
  )
)
INSERT INTO obs_n8n_executions (
  execution_id, created_at, workflow_id, workflow_name, status, mode, duration_ms, error_message
)
SELECT execution_id, created_at, workflow_id, workflow_name, status, mode, duration_ms, error_message
FROM rows
ON CONFLICT (execution_id) DO UPDATE SET
  workflow_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.workflow_name, obs_n8n_executions.workflow_name),
  status = EXCLUDED.status,
  duration_ms = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.duration_ms, obs_n8n_executions.duration_ms),
  error_message = COALESCE(obs_n8n_executions.error_message, EXCLUDED.error_message);
